Title: Luminary Brand Identity
ShortDescription: A luxury wellness brand identity built around light, clarity, and transformation.
Description: Luminary is a premium wellness brand that needed a visual identity reflecting their philosophy of transformation through light. The project encompassed logo design, typography system, color palette, packaging, and brand guidelines.
Problem: The client lacked a cohesive visual identity that communicated their premium positioning. Their existing materials were inconsistent and failed to convey the transformative, high-end experience they offered.
Approach: We began with deep brand discovery workshops to uncover core values and competitive positioning. Extensive moodboarding and conceptual exploration followed, testing multiple visual directions before converging on the final identity system.
Solution: A refined identity built around a custom wordmark paired with an abstract light-ray symbol. The palette uses luminous golds and deep navy to evoke transformation and luxury. The complete system covers digital and print touchpoints.

Title: Apex Dashboard UI
ShortDescription: A sophisticated analytics dashboard redesign for a fintech startup.
Description: Apex needed a complete redesign of their financial analytics dashboard. The new interface required handling complex data visualizations while maintaining an intuitive, premium user experience for high-net-worth clients.
Problem: The existing dashboard was cluttered and overwhelming, causing user drop-off and support requests. Data was poorly organized, making key insights difficult to surface quickly.
Approach: User research with 20+ clients revealed the 5 most critical data points users needed at a glance. We employed progressive disclosure principles and a modular component architecture to organize complexity.
Solution: A dark-mode dashboard with an intelligent hierarchy that surfaces critical insights immediately. Custom chart components with micro-animations, a gesture-based mobile experience, and a design system ensuring future scalability.

Title: Velour Editorial Campaign
ShortDescription: A bold editorial campaign for a luxury fashion label.
Description: Velour, an independent luxury fashion label, commissioned a complete editorial campaign for their Spring/Summer collection. The project included art direction, layout design, and digital and print asset production.
Problem: Velour needed campaign materials that would differentiate them in a crowded luxury market and resonate with a younger, design-savvy audience while maintaining brand prestige.
Approach: Intensive concept development exploring the season's theme of 'deconstruction and rebirth'. Collaborated with photographers and stylists to ensure visual language was consistent across all touchpoints.
Solution: A striking editorial system using fragmented typography, high-contrast imagery, and an unexpected color story. The campaign spanned magazine spreads, digital banners, social content, and lookbook design.

Title: Nova Mobile App
ShortDescription: End-to-end UX design for a mindfulness and meditation app.
Description: Nova is a mindfulness app targeting professionals experiencing burnout. I led the complete UX process from research and ideation through prototyping and final UI design, creating an experience that felt genuinely calming and premium.
Problem: Most meditation apps felt clinical or overly gamified. Nova wanted to differentiate through a design language that was genuinely serene, personal, and effortless to navigate.
Approach: Extended user research including diary studies with 30 participants revealed key friction points in competitors. We defined a 'calm UX' framework prioritizing gentle interactions, reduced cognitive load, and ambient aesthetics.
Solution: A fluid, gesture-driven interface with a biomorphic design language. Soft gradients, generous whitespace, and subtle haptic feedback patterns create an experience that begins calming users before they've even started a session.

Title: Forma Architecture Website
ShortDescription: A minimal, image-led website for an award-winning architecture firm.
Description: Forma is a critically acclaimed architecture studio that needed a website as considered and precise as their buildings. The site needed to convey the firm's philosophy and portfolio with the same restraint and intentionality found in their work.
Problem: Their previous website was generic and template-driven, failing to reflect the firm's reputation for thoughtful, high-craft design. It also lacked a coherent content strategy.
Approach: We structured the site around the concept of 'negative space as content', letting the architecture breathe. Information architecture was rebuilt from the ground up through stakeholder interviews and competitor analysis.
Solution: A brutalist-minimal website with full-viewport imagery, considered micro-typography, and deliberate pacing. Navigation is almost invisible, keeping focus entirely on the work. Load times are under 2 seconds despite large imagery.

Title: Orbit Packaging System
ShortDescription: Sustainable packaging design for a premium direct-to-consumer snack brand.
Description: Orbit needed packaging that communicated their commitment to sustainable, high-quality ingredients while standing out on competitive retail shelves. The system had to scale across 12 SKUs and work equally well in digital channels.
Problem: The brand was launching into a saturated health snack category where most competitors used predictable green-and-earthy visual cues. Orbit needed to look premium while signaling sustainability.
Approach: We explored an unexpected design direction: deep, cosmic color palettes paired with clean, science-inspired typography to position the brand at the intersection of nature and innovation.
Solution: A modular packaging system with a dark cosmic color range, custom illustrated ingredient icons, and clear hierarchy. The system uses only FSC-certified materials and soy inks, with compostable structures across the range.
